name: Crow's Cache: carrier cannot use Hearthstone, Homebound Portal or Auto-Unstuck (#12065)
contract: Issue #12065: a Crow's Cache carrier could Hearthstone out of the open world while holding the cache. Commit 04b6f8e713 (PR #12740) refused SPELL_EFFECT_TELEPORT_UNITS (including Hearthstone 8690) and dropped the cache on map change, but Homebound Portal (item 97758, GO 80775, spell 93187 — SPELL_EFFECT_DUMMY teleporting to the portal owner's hearthstone bind in AscensionTravelPermit.cpp) and Stuck (7355, SPELL_EFFECT_STUCK) bypassed CrowsCache::MovesCaster.

An Undead level-60 High-Risk Mercenary mage claims the Thousand Needles Crow's Cache while a second Undead mage stands nearby with a Homebound Portal (97758 -> 93186 -> GO 80775). Both players have their default Undead homebind on map 0 (Tirisfal Glades), while the cache is on map 1 (Kalimdor).

Expected while carrying Crow's Cache (1615010): Hearthstone (8690), stepping into the Homebound Portal (93187) and Stuck (7355) are all refused (cast_failure >= 1), leaving the carrier on map 1 at its Thousand Needles position still holding the cache. Control: the second mage (not carrying Crow's Cache) steps through the exact same Homebound Portal and arrives on map 0.

Nothing is probabilistic. Spell and item ids were read from the CoA Spell.dbc and item_template. Requires CrowsCache.Enable=1 and Bloodforged.Enable=1 with released Heroic Bloodforged rewards and automatic cycles deferred.
